name: RUN
source:
RUN is set in a dystopian future where, for several years, the surface of the Earth has become uninhabitable due to catastrophic events that have led to only a few people being able to survive in colonies and bunkers scattered across the planet.
Living in a colony named Terra's Legacy are Bram and Adrian, who, on a poorly planned escape from the atrocities committed by a tyrant, end up repeating the same mistake that led to disaster years ago, but this time with even worse consequences.
Now, Bram finds himself lost and alone in the desert, with no reason to continue or to turn back; his empty hopes, malnutrition, and dehydration are taking over quickly, leaving the fennec between life and death. Will Bram be able to forgive himself in this new world filled with danger? Only time will tell.

[From [url=https://hiraethprojects.itch.io/run]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《RUN》的故事设定在一个反乌托邦未来。灾难性事件让地表数年来都不再适宜居住，只有少数人得以在散布全球的殖民地与地下掩体中存活。
Bram和Adrian住在名为Terra's Legacy的殖民地。两人仓促策划逃离暴君犯下的暴行，却重蹈了多年前导致灾难的覆辙，这一次后果更加严重。
如今，Bram在沙漠中迷失方向、孤身一人，既没有继续前进的理由，也不愿回头。空洞的希望、营养不良与脱水正迅速吞噬他，让这只耳廓狐徘徊在生死边缘。在这个危机四伏的新世界里，Bram能否原谅自己？只有时间会给出答案。

[来源：[url=https://hiraethprojects.itch.io/run]Itch.io[/url]]
